newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-PSG WIN 1-0, MONACO CELEBRATIONS POSTPONED.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PSG WIN 1-0, MONACO CELEBRATIONS POSTPONED.

text.p: Paris St Germain kept Monaco's French league title celebrations on hold with a 1-0 win at Lille on Wednesday.
Right back Jimmy Algerino headed home in the 14th minute as PSG reduced Monaco's lead to nine points with three games to play.
Monaco won 2-0 at Strasbourg on Tuesday to virtually ensure their sixth championship but PSG retain a slim mathematical chance of overtaking them.
Nantes extended their unbeaten run in the league to 28 games with a 3-1 win away over 10-man Nancy to stay in third place three points behind PSG.

Nancy defender Cedric Lecluse was sent off after half an hour for bringing down Japhet N'Doram from behind inside the box. N'Doram converted the penalty for his second goal of the game and 20th in the championship.
